Title: Public preview: Policy-driven resiliency in Azure Container Apps

Body.Content:
Azure Container Apps now offers new built-in capabilities for resiliency.

Available in public preview, the new resiliency feature enables you to seamlessly recover from service-to-service request and outbound dependency failures just by adding simple policies. Several policies are built in for retries, back-offs and circuit breakers.  The policies are also customizable to meet unique workload needs.

Behind the scenes, the resiliency feature is powered by Dapr resiliency, however, it requires no special deployment, coding or knowledge of Dapr. 

Read more about Azure Container Apps resiliency powered by Distributed Application Runtime (Dapr) here: https://aka.ms/aca-resiliency
